recommendation_issues.problem: The command runner works but is not the lightest fix. Stryker's docs say coverageAnalysis 'all' runs every test for each covered mutant ('all: Stryker will determine the mutants covered by your tests during the initial test run phase'), and the vitest-runner sets testNamePattern only when a per-test filter is passed. Keeping @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner with coverageAnalysis: 'all' avoids the bug with one config line and keeps in-process runs instead of spawning vitest per mutant. Either way, set thresholds.break and drop the workaround once a release containing PR #6214 ships. Source: https://stryker-mutator.io/docs/stryker-js/configuration/ (accessed 2026-10-05).

Acceptable and it lowers the dependency count, but two steps are missing. Without a throwaway container, a crashed run leaves the template and worker databases behind, so the coordinator hook first removes them with DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS ... WITH (FORCE) (PostgreSQL 18 docs: 'Attempt to terminate all existing connections to the target database.'). Compose and the CI service must pin the same postgres:18 image tag so local and CI runs test the same server.

Correct but not free: a new app per scenario repeats Better Auth setup, pg-boss start and TestClock attach in every scenario (pg-boss docs: 'start() attaches the clock after schema installation; stop() releases it and restores real time'). If run time grows, giving each scenario its own remoteAddress on inject (a light-my-request option) isolates the in-memory rate-limit counters with one app per worker. Keep the per-scenario rebuild only if other in-memory state leaks.

Hand-listing pg-boss internal tables is brittle: pg-boss 12 has eleven tables plus a test clock table and ships frequent minors (12.36.0 on 2026-10-02). A version-proof rule: TRUNCATE only the application schema (public; Drizzle keeps its migration log in schema 'drizzle' by default), and clear jobs through pg-boss's API. pgboss.io/api/jobs: deleteAllJobs() 'Deletes all jobs in a queue, including active jobs. If no queue name is given, jobs are deleted from all queues.'

Justification partly wrong (Python is preinstalled on the runner and an official action exists); keep the deferral but state the real reasons. The replacement model test hits the database, so it should run as one Cucumber scenario whose step calls fc.assert with asyncModelRun (fast-check is runner-agnostic), with a reset per run and a small explicit numRuns. Running it in Vitest would need a second database harness, which adds moving parts.

For the postgres:18 image a CI tmpfs must target /var/lib/postgresql (PGDATA is /var/lib/postgresql/18/docker and the VOLUME moved to /var/lib/postgresql), not the old /var/lib/postgresql/data. If F05 is accepted, the -c flags go through the service container's command key, available since 2026-04-02 (GitHub changelog: 'You can use the new entrypoint and command keys to override the image defaults from your workflow YAML.'). The dev compose container then also runs without durability, which is fine for dev data only.
